svg.text: Terrain from OpenStreetMap — the wizard: 1 Area, 2 Options (DESIGN_Terrain_From_OSM.md §6)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Drag a box on the map, or search a place.
The content check runs in Preview —
a town packs ≈ 1 000 buildings per km²;
HROT is tuned for ≈ 1 800 in all.
① Area — the map is OSM's standard map tiles (not satellite), with the attribution; pan with the mouse, wheel to zoom, Fit = the box.
Search = Nominatim; picking a result centres the map and proposes a box of the place's size (clamped to 6 × 6 km).
The box: drag on empty map to draw, drag inside to move, the 8 handles to resize; the size chip turns RED above 6 km and Next greys.
enterable houses; garages and sheds solid
woods, scrub, lone trees, tree rows
Buildings without a height in OSM
Used only where OSM has no levels, no height
and no known building type (≈ 1 in 3 buildings).
Roads always come in (they cannot be switched off).
A terrain named "kolin-centre" exists — tick Replace to overwrite it.
Replace — used by 2 scenarios: kolin-patrol, kolin-cordon
② Options — the name is checked as you type (a valid folder name; green tick = new, amber row = exists → Replace with the scenarios that use it).
Everything else follows the design's rules; there is no per-building editing (one-shot, Q-O5) — to change anything, import again.
